title: 이 집은 줄 서서라도 먹어야 돼

story.text: 규현이 지도 앱을 보여주며 자신 있게 말했다. "여기 완전 찐 맛집이에요. 제가 책임질게요."
story.reading: gyu-hyeon-i ji-do aeb-eul bo-yeo-ju-myeo ja-sin it-ge mal-haet-da. "yeo-gi wan-jeon jjin mat-jib-i-e-yo. je-ga chaeg-im-jil-ge-yo."
story.en: Kyuhyun showed me a map app, speaking with total confidence. "This place is a legit hidden gem. I'll take full responsibility."

story.text: 골목 안쪽 식당 앞에는 이미 긴 줄이 늘어서 있었다. "웨이팅이 이 정도면 맛은 보장된 거예요, 아가씨."
story.reading: gol-mok an-jjok sik-dang ap-e-neun i-mi gin jul-i neul-eo-seo iss-eot-da. "we-i-ting-i i jeong-do-myeon mas-eun bo-jang-doen geo-ye-yo, a-ga-ssi."
story.en: A long line already stretched in front of the restaurant tucked inside the alley. "With a wait like this, the taste is guaranteed, miss."

story.text: 삼십 분 넘게 기다린 끝에 자리에 앉자, 규현은 익숙하게 메뉴 두어 개를 골랐다. "여기는 이모님이 저 단골인 거 아시거든요."
story.reading: sam-sib bun neom-ge gi-da-lin kkeut-e ja-ri-e anj-ja, gyu-hyeon-eun ik-suk-ha-ge me-nyu du-eo gae-reul gol-lat-da. "yeo-gi-neun i-mo-nim-i jeo dan-gol-in geo a-si-geo-deun-yo."
story.en: After waiting over thirty minutes, we finally sat down, and Kyuhyun casually ordered a couple of dishes like he'd done it a hundred times. "The owner here knows I'm a regular."

story.text: 김이 모락모락 나는 그릇이 테이블에 놓이자마자, 그는 앞접시에 먼저 덜어서 내 쪽으로 밀어 주었다. "일단 먹어 보고 판단해요."
story.reading: gim-i mo-rak-mo-rak na-neun geu-reus-i te-i-beul-e noh-i-ja-ma-ja, geu-neun ap-jeob-si-e meon-jeo deol-eo-seo nae jjog-eu-ro mil-eo ju-eot-da. "il-dan meog-eo bo-go pan-dan-hae-yo."
story.en: The moment a steaming bowl landed on the table, he scooped some onto a small plate first and slid it over to me. "Just try it before you decide."

story.text: 한 입 먹자마자 나도 모르게 감탄사가 터져 나왔다. "미쳤다, 이거 진짜 맛있어요." 규현이 흐뭇하게 웃으며 반찬 하나를 더 나눠 먹자며 덜어 주었다.
story.reading: han ib meok-ja-ma-ja na-do mo-reu-ge gam-tan-sa-ga teo-jyeo na-wat-da. "mi-chyeot-da, i-geo jin-jja mas-iss-eo-yo." gyu-hyeon-i heu-mut-ha-ge us-eu-myeo ban-chan ha-na-reul deo na-nwo meok-ja-myeo deol-eo ju-eot-da.
story.en: The moment I took a bite, an exclamation burst out of me before I could stop it. "This is insane, it's actually so good." Kyuhyun smiled fondly and scooped out another side dish for us to share.

story.text: "거봐요, 제 입맛 믿으라니까." 그가 어깨를 으쓱하며 젓가락을 다시 들었다. "그래서, 여기 또 올 거죠?"
story.reading: "geo-bwa-yo, je ib-mat mid-eu-ra-ni-kka." geu-ga eo-kkae-reul eu-sseuk-ha-myeo jeot-ga-rag-eul da-si deul-eot-da. "geu-rae-seo, yeo-gi tto ol geo-jyo?"
story.en: "See? I told you to trust my taste." He shrugged and picked his chopsticks back up. "So? You're coming back here again, right?"

story.text: 배가 부른데도 그는 근처 후식 맛집까지 나를 이끌었다. "밥은 배로 먹고, 디저트는 마음으로 먹는 거예요."
story.reading: bae-ga bu-reun-de-do geu-neun geun-cheo hu-sik mat-jib-kka-ji na-reul i-kkeul-eot-da. "bab-eun bae-ro meok-go, di-jeo-teu-neun ma-eum-eu-ro meong-neun geo-ye-yo."
story.en: Even though I was already full, he dragged me off to a dessert spot nearby. "You eat a meal with your stomach, but dessert you eat with your heart."

story.text: 줄 서고, 나눠 먹고, 또 줄 선 하루였지만 이상하게 하나도 힘들지 않았다. 규현과 함께라면 기다림조차 즐거웠다.
story.reading: jul seo-go, na-nwo meok-go, tto jul seon ha-ru-yeot-ji-man i-sang-ha-ge ha-na-do him-deul-ji an-at-da. gyu-hyeon-gwa ham-kke-ra-myeon gi-da-lim-jo-cha jeul-geo-wot-da.
story.en: A day of standing in line, sharing food, then standing in line again — but strangely, none of it felt tiring. With Kyuhyun, even the waiting was fun.
